BackstoryDef.title: low-G adjuster
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up without gravity, so [PAWN_possessive] childhood was one long course of rehabilitation and gravity exposure therapy. The treatments left [PAWN_objective] able to move normally under full gravity, but [PAWN_possessive] body is still far weaker than those of other children [PAWN_possessive] age.

BackstoryDef.title: officer cadet
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] performed well enough at the colonial military academy to be trained as an officer cadet while still a child, and made warrant officer on reaching adulthood.

BackstoryDef.title: child orderly
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up on a colonial planet in permanent turmoil, running messages across front lines thick with jamming and hostile fire because nothing else could get through. Once the war ended, [PAWN_pronoun] finally got to go back to school.

BackstoryDef.title: son of martyrs
BackstoryDef.description: Both of [PAWN_nameDef]'s parents were declared missing in action on deployment while [PAWN_pronoun] was very young. Under the colonial fleet's military martyrdom clause, [PAWN_pronoun] received a scholarship that carried [PAWN_objective] through the officer academy course.

BackstoryDef.title: camp bastard
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born out of wedlock in a colonial fleet camp on the planet's surface, and [PAWN_possessive] biological father was never named. The soldiers stationed there raised [PAWN_objective] as one of their own, which gave [PAWN_objective] something close to a whole childhood.

BackstoryDef.title: debt inheritor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s family could not repay their loans, and were shipped out to the rimworld along with [PAWN_possessive] parents. The rimworld killed them both without ceremony, and [PAWN_nameDef] somehow inherited the family debt along with everything else.

BackstoryDef.title: organ dodger
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] signed an organ donation contract early in life, promising healthy organs on reaching adulthood. Being clever, [PAWN_pronoun] spent the contract money on the right connections, talked [PAWN_objective]self onto a frontier project, and fled to the rimworld before anyone came to collect.

BackstoryDef.title: colonist descendant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] descends from a colonial fleet that settled this rimworld. After the fleet moved on, the megacorporations moved in, and the price of simply staying alive climbed year after year. [PAWN_pronoun] was taught to shoot before [PAWN_pronoun] was taught much else.

BackstoryDef.title: dragoon shell refugee
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent childhood days scavenging for anything worth keeping, and childhood nights sheltering inside the gutted shell of a mobile dragoon in the war zone - right up until [PAWN_possessive] body grew too big to fit inside it.

BackstoryDef.title: middle-class child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up comfortable and well educated. Even so, there were far more qualified people than there were positions, and every path upward was already blocked - so [PAWN_pronoun] went looking for opportunity out on the rim instead.

BackstoryDef.title: child of war
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born in a conflict zone in the middle of a nationalist surge. The talent for combat [PAWN_pronoun] showed there made the outcome obvious, and [PAWN_pronoun] ended up a mercenary. [PAWN_pronoun] rarely thinks about much beyond the fight in front of [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: young adventurer
BackstoryDef.description: Young [PAWN_nameDef] dreamed of being an adventurer, and signed onto a frontier project bound for the rimworld without telling anyone. It did not take long to learn what that dream actually cost.

BackstoryDef.title: automatroid enthusiast
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] thought automatroids were the coolest thing in existence, and studied everything about them that could be scraped together under difficult circumstances. That work eventually earned [PAWN_objective] an invitation from the academic faction.
